Toshik Nandanwar

CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT


7798123134
toshiknandanwar76@gmail.com
www.linkedin.com/in/toshik-nandanwar
SUMMARY

Chartered Accountant with proven skills in cash flow
projections, budgeting, and financial analysis for
projects over ₹5 crore. Delivered accurate tax
compliance, audit support, and process optimization
across multiple industries, using advanced Excel and
strong analytical abilities.
EXTRA CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES

	Market Place Simulation by CA Monk :


	Participated in a marketplace simulation, making
pricing and investment decisions to drive revenue
and profitability using cost and margin analysis.

	Analyzed market trends and competitor data to
support decisionmaking, strengthening P&L
understanding and financial planning skills.


	Investment Banking Simulation (J.P.Morgen) by
forage :


	Evaluated M&A targets using strategic and
financial criteria; performed revenue, profitability,
and valuation analysis.

	Built financial model to project performance and
support investment decisions.

	Delivered structured investment recommendation
based on business analysis and deal dynamics.


SKILLS

Software Proficiency: Tally Prime/ERP 9, MS Word,
Advance MS Excel, MS Power point, Spectrum,
Compuoffice, Power BI, AI for Finance, Excel VBA

Soft Skills: Analytical Thinking & Problem-Solving,
Attention to Detail & Accuracy, Time Management &
Meeting Deadlines, Effective Communication

AWARDS AND CERTIFICATIONS

Typing Proficiency Feb 2026
ICAI DUBAI
Investor Awareness Test Mar 2026
NISM

CA Final Exemptions: FR 61, AFM 71, DT 60

Score: 54%

RTMNU Nagpur

Score: 9.28 CGPA

Class XII

MSBSHSE Nagpur

Score: 82.77%

Class X

MSBSHSE Nagpur

Score: 67%


EXPERIENCE

Article Assistant

Mar 2022 - Mar 2025
Budhraja and Company Nagpur, Maharashtra
It is a reputed Chartered Accountancy firm with 25+ years of
experience, specializing in audit, tax, project financing, and advisory
services.
	Project Financing & FP&A :


	Developed sales forecasts and annual operating plans (AOP),
performed variance analysis and comparative analysis across
different industries, tracked key performance indicators (KPIs),
applied flywheel and sales funnel concepts, and analyzed margin
improvements.

	Led the preparation of CMA reports and developed detailed
financial projections for term loans and working capital facilities,
impacting over 30 clients across various industries, with a total
project value exceeding ₹5 crore.

	Conducted cash flow projections, ratio analysis, and profitability
assessments, forecasting and variance analysis independently,
directly influencing credit decision-making processes.

	Actively involved in analyzing financial statements and building
forward-looking projections, strengthening budgeting and
forecasting capabilities aligned with FP&A functions.

	Oversaw data validation and documentation processes,
coordinating with stakeholders to ensure the accuracy and timely
submission of loan proposals, enhancing the efficiency of financial
operations.


	Direct Tax :


	Reviewed and filed over 200 Income Tax Returns for individuals
and business entities, achieving 100% compliance and accuracy,
thereby minimizing audit risks.

	Contributed to tax audits under Section 44AB, including
preparation of Forms 3CA/3CB/3CD.

	Reviewed books, ensured TDS/TCS compliance, and identified key
adjustments in financial records.

	Detected and resolved discrepancies, improving accuracy of
financial reporting and compliance.


	Indirect Tax : Filed GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and assisted in GSTR-9 &
GSTR-9C.

	Performed GST reconciliations (Books vs Returns vs 2A/2B) and
ensured statutory compliance.


	Audit and assurance :


	Led statutory audits for automobile manufacturing companies,
verifying revenue streams, inventory levels, and fixed assets,
ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

	Evaluated compliance with Companies Auditor's Report) Order
CARO requirements, and prepared working papers.

	Conducted stock audits, including physical verification and
reconciliation with books of accounts.

	Assisted in preparation and finalization of financial statements in
accordance with applicable accounting standards.
